Panipat keeps two big industrial engines running — the refinery belt out on Refinery Road and the HUDA/HSIIDC sectors full of manufacturing and textile units — and both keep work going that needs site offices, gate cabins, and supervisor rooms. SAMAN builds those cabins. We manufacture IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and run them up the NH-44 to Panipat in 3 to 5 days, ready to set on your plinth. A guard cabin at a Sector-29 HUDA plot or a multi-room contractor office on a Refinery Road project — call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 and we'll quote it.

Why Buy Your Porta Cabin From SAMAN

Search "porta cabin in Panipat" and you mostly hit IndiaMART listings — dozens of sellers, prices from about ₹50,000 to over ₹2 lakh, with little to separate them. The cards seldom tell you the steel grade, the panel thickness, or how the cabin's fixed down. For a Refinery Road contractor job or a Sector-25 unit running for years, that's the detail that decides whether the cabin holds up.

We make the porta cabins, so when you call you reach the people who build them. Standard on every SAMAN unit:

  • A frame in IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections — welded, primed, powder-coated, then anchor-bolted to your plinth so it stays put.
  • 50 mm PUF sandwich panel walls — insulation that handles a Panipat summer and a cold winter both.
  • A colour-coated GI roof, pitched to drain the monsoon, with a false ceiling under it.
  • A pre-wired board — MCB, ELCB earthing, points and tube-light provision.

The paperwork is real. ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. We started in 2009 and incorporated in 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd — POS is Portable Office Solutions. Over 500 projects delivered, and being up the NH-44, Panipat is a short, easy run for us.

Delivery runs ₹3,000 standard, transit to Panipat is 3–5 days, and returns are 7 days with the return freight on you.

Where Porta Cabins Go to Work in Panipat

Panipat's work splits across a few clear belts, and the cabin you need follows the plot:

The HUDA / HSIIDC industrial sectors (Sectors 24, 25, 29, PIN 132103) — the manufacturing and textile heart of the city, with hundreds of units. Steady demand for gate security cabins and supervisor offices, and multi-room blocks on the larger plots.

The Refinery Road belt (PIN 132140) — the heavy-industry corridor around the refinery and its feeder units. Contractor offices, site stores, and security cabins, often several at once during shutdown and expansion work.

Beyond the estates, Panipat has plenty of construction: the NH-44/GT Road widening, warehouse parks, thermal-power-area work, and housing. All of it runs on porta cabins as the site office and the gate while the build is on.

Because we dispatch from Greater Noida straight up the NH-44, Panipat is one of our shorter hauls — a clean 3–5 day schedule. It's the same factory-direct run we make up and down the NCR belt, from our porta cabin in Sonipat work to our porta cabin in Manesar deliveries.

What You're Actually Getting — Specifications

Built for the NCR climate: hot summers, a real winter, a monsoon.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow sections, welded and zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panel as standard — insulation that works both ways across Panipat's hot-and-cold year. Cement board for a tougher skin on a long posting.

Roof: colour-coated GI sheet, pitched for drainage, false ceiling underneath. Turbo ventilators for open plots with no shade.

Floor: anti-skid chequered MS plate, or laminate for a sit-down office.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coated, louvre or sliding windows, fixed glazing on request. All fitted at the factory.

Electricals: MCB board pre-wired, 2 to 4 points a room, tube-light points, ELCB earthing.

Sizes off the shelf: 8×10, 10×12, 10×20 (the common 20 ft office), 10×30, 10×40 (the 40 ft block). Odd size? We'll build to it.

Layouts: single room, two-room, a full multi-room block, with an attached toilet or a pantry if you need one.

What People in Panipat Use Them For

  • Gate security cabins at HUDA-sector and Refinery Road plot entries
  • Multi-room contractor offices on refinery and warehouse projects
  • Portable office cabins and supervisor rooms at HSIIDC units
  • Worker accommodation blocks on the larger project sites
  • Site stores for tools and material at project yards
  • Site-management offices on NH-44 and GT Road construction

Customising It to Your Site

Most orders aren't the bare standard. Common changes:

  • Custom size and multi-room layouts
  • AC provision (wall sleeve cut and a power point) for a summer office
  • Extra wall and roof insulation for the Panipat winter
  • Turbo ventilator and false ceiling for open, shadeless plots
  • Internal partitions, extra doors or windows
  • Plumbing run for an attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where the load numbers allow

Tell us the plot and the use; we'll confirm the spec and the price at quote stage.

What a Porta Cabin Costs in Panipat

On the marketplaces you'll see Panipat prices from about ₹50,000 for a small basic unit up to ₹2.1 lakh and more, with material and size noted on the cards. The spread is wide because no two cabins are the same. What moves the number:

  1. Size — an 8×10 single room is the floor, a 10×40 block the ceiling.
  2. Panel — standard PUF, or cement board for a tougher build.
  3. Fit-out — bare shell, or fully done with wiring, flooring, paint and AC.
  4. Climate kit — ventilator, false ceiling, extra insulation, AC provision.
  5. Quantity — order five or more and the per-unit price comes down.

For a real number on your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Getting It to Your Panipat Site

We load on a flatbed at Greater Noida and run it up the NH-44 — one of our shorter hauls, the same dispatch behind the porta cabins delivered across Gurgaon and the NCR. Three to five days in transit. When it lands, we set it on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolt it, check the panels, and connect the board. A single room is usable within hours; a multi-room block takes about a day to settle. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard — ask for a combined rate if you're taking several. One thing to be clear about: we don't have a yard or branch in Panipat. Every cabin is built to your order at the factory and trucked straight to your plot.

Looking After It

A SAMAN cabin needs very little. Wash the dust off the panels now and then, keep the roof drains clear before the monsoon, and check the door and window fittings once a year. The powder-coated MS frame and GI roof take years of site use with that light attention — no annual repainting, no special upkeep.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Panipat

Do you deliver porta cabins to the HUDA sectors and Refinery Road?

Yes — the HUDA/HSIIDC sectors, the Refinery Road belt, and construction sites across Panipat. The cabin ships from our Greater Noida factory up the NH-44 and takes 3–5 days, since Panipat is one of our closer cities. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard.

What does a porta cabin cost in Panipat?

Marketplace listings run from about ₹50,000 for a small basic unit to over ₹2.1 lakh — but the real number depends on size, panel type, fit-out and quantity. We quote against your exact spec rather than publish a fixed price. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry.

What sizes and layouts can I get?

Stock sizes run 8×10, 10×12, 10×20 (the common 20 ft office), 10×30, and 10×40 ft, in single-room, two-room, or full multi-room layouts, with an attached toilet or pantry on request. Need an odd size? We build to it.

Can you supply multiple cabins for a refinery or HSIIDC project?

Yes. We supply contractors and project managers, and our NSIC, DPIIT, ISO certificates, GST registration and incorporation papers are ready for vendor empanelment. Send the project scope and we'll confirm what we can supply and by when.

How long from order to delivery in Panipat?

Transit is 3–5 days once the cabin's built, since Panipat is a short run up the NH-44. Production time depends on the configuration and your place in the queue — standard sizes move quicker. We'll give you a firm timeline at enquiry.

Get a Porta Cabin in Panipat

Need a porta cabin in Panipat — for a HUDA-sector unit, a Refinery Road project, or a city construction site? Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or drop your requirement in the enquiry form. We'll come back with the right spec for your plot, a delivery date, and a firm price. You can also browse our portable site cabins with clear pricing for sizes and configurations.
